investment_synthesis: CMRY screens as a high-quality, cash-generative staples name with a net cash balance sheet, top-quartile profitability, and healthy growth. However, the shares trade at a premium multiple versus most peers, while several comparables offer similar or stronger growth at materially lower valuations. We view CMRY as a quality core holding, but the current risk/reward appears balanced relative to cheaper peers in the set.
key_strengths: High business quality: ROIC 24.3% and ROE 27.4%, among the group’s leaders; quarterly operating margin ~24% is top-tier
Robust growth: revenue up ~22.7% YoY and net income up ~71.8% YoY
Low financial risk: net cash position (−1.22T), exceptional interest coverage (~1,031x), strong liquidity (current ratio 2.71), and best-in-group Altman Z-score (9.22)
Solid cash flow quality: positive FCF (1.58T) and efficient working capital (cash conversion cycle ~47 days)
key_risks: Premium valuation: PE ~22.9 vs many peers in single-digit to mid-teens (e.g., INDF 8.4, TAPG 8.9, JPFA 8.8, CPIN 16.3); PEG ~1.03 vs several peers well below 1
Smaller absolute cash generation than larger peers (CFO 2.06T vs INDF 17.53T, ICBP 12.68T), potentially limiting scale advantages
Debt-to-equity data not disclosed in the set for CMRY (though net cash and coverage metrics mitigate leverage concerns)
further_due_diligence: Assess sustainability of ~24% operating margins and drivers of recent earnings growth (pricing, mix, volume, cost tailwinds)
Validate capital allocation priorities (reinvestment, dividends) and consistency of FCF conversion versus EPS
Confirm working capital discipline given short cash conversion cycle and inventory turnover trends
Reconcile missing debt-to-equity disclosure; verify off-balance sheet or contingent liabilities
Benchmark competitive position and pricing power versus TAPG, CPIN, INDF, and JPFA
relative_positioning: Quality leader with net cash and strong profitability; growth is healthy, but valuation is less compelling than several peers offering comparable or better growth at lower multiples.
investment_profile: Quality compounder with low balance sheet risk, trading at a relative premium
